title: Senior Systems Engineer – Web Hosting
description:
**Company Description** 
 CSpace Web Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is an India\-based provider of Infrastructure as a Service and IP network solutions with a core focus on IT security. The organization delivers 24/7 managed services to help clients protect and monitor their digital assets. Its teams design secure, reliable hosting and network environments tailored to business needs. Professionals joining CSpace Web Solutions can expect to work in a security\-conscious environment that prioritizes resilience, performance, and continuous improvement.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Senior Systems Engineer – Web Hosting is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Pune Division. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining web hosting infrastructure, including servers, virtualization platforms, and related network services. Daily activities include monitoring system performance, managing backups, applying security patches, and ensuring high availability of hosting environments. The engineer will troubleshoot complex technical issues, coordinate with support teams, and optimize systems for scalability and reliability. The role also involves documenting configurations, contributing to security best practices, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to support customer hosting solutions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Server \& Datacenter:** 



* Manage, configure, and maintain physical and virtual servers (Linux and Windows)
* Datacenter deployment: rack/stack, cabling, OS install, network bring\-up, burn\-in, and handoff to production
* Install and manage OS and services via remote consoles (IPMI, iDRAC, iLO, KVM)



**Virtualization** 
 : Work with Proxmox, SolusVM, Virtualizor, and/or Hyper\-V
 



**Hosting Stack** 
 :
 


* Administer cPanel/WHM and Plesk
* Support DNS, email, Apache, MySQL/MariaDB; IIS/MSSQL exposure is a plus



**Monitoring, Troubleshooting \& Automation:** 



* Debug Linux and Windows issues; use SNMP and BMC/out\-of\-band management
* Monitor hardware, applications, and network; resolve incidents proactively
* Automate with Ansible (and related scripting)
* **Client \& Team** 
 : Coordinate with client, network/vendors during deployments and incidents.



  





**Qualifications** 



* 4–6 years in web hosting / managed server operations
* Strong cPanel/WHM and Linux experience; Plesk preferred
* Experience with on\-prem virtualization (Proxmox / SolusVM / Virtualizor; Hyper\-V nice to have)
* Hands\-on datacenter work (rack, cable, install, remote console, hardware RMA)
* Familiarity with Ansible for deployment/config automation
* Monitoring exposure: Icinga2 / Zabbix / LibreNMS / Grafana–Prometheus (any solid stack)
* Solid networking fundamentals: DNS, TCP/IP, VLANs, common hosting protocols
* Strong troubleshooting and communication skills
* English \+ Hindi \+ Marathi Communication.
* Willing to work from Pune and visit datacenter as needed (including occasional odd hours for installs/cutovers)



  





**Nice to Have** 



* NOC\-PS or similar provisioning tooling
* Windows hosting (IIS, MSSQL)
* Hardware health via iLO / iDRAC / IPMI / Redfish
* Prior on\-call / NOC shift experience
* Experience with structured cabling, switch uplinks, and IPMI/management networks



  





**What We Offer** 



* Hands\-on ownership of production hosting and datacenter deployment work in Pune
* Growth into automation, monitoring, and senior ops responsibility
* Competitive compensation based on experience and skill

title: Systems Engineer
description:
**Location:** 
 Pune, Maharashtra, India
   

  

**Experience:** 
 4–7 Years
   

  

**Notice Period :** 
 15 days Max or Immediate Joiners Only
   

  

**Communication Skills :** 
 Mandatory excellent communication skills in English
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Work Mode:** 
 On\-site / Hybrid, as applicable, 24X7 rotational Shifts.
   

  

**Shift:** 
 Standard business hours with occasional after\-hours/on\-call support as required
   

  

**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Tier 2 Windows Support Engineer** 
 to join our Infrastructure Support team. The engineer will be responsible for day\-to\-day administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, maintenance, and support of Windows Server environments.
   

  

 The role will primarily focus on
 **Windows Server, patching, monitoring, incident management, and operational support** 
 .
   

  

 The candidate should be comfortable independently troubleshooting common infrastructure issues and working with Tier 1, Tier 3, Network, Database, Security, and other infrastructure teams when escalation is required.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Windows Server Administration**
* Provide Tier 2 support for Windows Server environments.
* Administration and troubleshooting of Windows Server 2016/2019/2022\.
* Perform server health checks and investigate performance\-related issues.
* Troubleshoot CPU, memory, disk, service, event log, and OS\-related issues.
* Start/stop/restart Windows services as required.
* Troubleshoot server connectivity and application/service availability issues.


**Patching \& Maintenance**
* Perform Windows Server patching activities according to the approved patching schedule.
* Experience in managing Patching tools like ManageEngine Patch Manager, NinjaOne, etc.
* Experience in Setting up automations.
* Validate server health before and after patching.
* Troubleshoot patching failures.
* Perform post\-patching validation.
* Maintain patching records and update operational documentation.
* Support vulnerability remediation activities related to Windows servers.


**Monitoring \& Incident Management**
* Monitor Windows server infrastructure using enterprise monitoring tools.
* Investigate and resolve alerts within defined SLAs.
* Handle Tier 2 incidents and service requests.
* Perform initial troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis.
* Escalate complex or recurring issues to Tier 3 teams.
* Maintain accurate ticket updates and technical documentation.
* Participate in Problem Management and Change Management activities.


**Documentation \& Process**
* Maintain server documentation and operational procedures.
* Update Knowledge Base articles and troubleshooting guides.
* Follow ITIL\-based Incident, Request, Change, and Problem Management processes.
* Participate in operational reviews and provide status updates.
* Maintain accurate records of infrastructure changes and activities.


**Required Technical Skills**
**Must Have**
* 2–5 years of experience in Windows Server administration/support.
* Hands\-on experience with Windows Server 2016/2019/2022\.
* Good knowledge of Active Directory.
* Good understanding of Group Policy.
* Working knowledge of DNS and DHCP.
* Experience troubleshooting Windows Server issues.
* Understanding of TCP/IP and basic networking concepts.
* Experience with server patching and maintenance.
* Experience working with ITSM/ticketing tools such as ServiceNow.
* Good incident troubleshooting and documentation skills.
* AI and Automation Fluency.


**Good to Have**
* Basic PowerShell scripting.
* Knowledge of monitoring tools.
* Experience with WSUS/SCCM,Patch Manager, NinjaOne
* ITIL Foundation certification.


**Candidate Profile**
**We Are Looking For Someone Who**
* Has strong troubleshooting ability rather than only theoretical knowledge.
* Can independently handle common Windows Server incidents.
* Is comfortable working in a structured IT operations environment.
* Understands SLA\-based support.
* Has good written and verbal communication skills.
* Can work effectively with L1, L3, Network, Database, Security, and Application teams.
* Is willing to take ownership of incidents until resolution or appropriate escalation.
* Is comfortable working with documented processes and change controls.


**Education**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
   

  

 Relevant hands\-on experience may be considered in lieu of formal qualifications.
   

  

**Certifications**
 Certifications are
 **preferred but not mandatory** 
 .
   

  

**Examples**
* Microsoft Windows Server / Microsoft certifications
* Azure Fundamentals
* ITIL Foundation

title: Systems Engineer (Diagnostic Calibration Engineer)
description:
**Requisition Summary**
**PACCAR India** 
 is looking for a skilled
 **Systems Engineer (Diagnostic Calibration Engineer)** 
 to join its dynamic team in Pune. The role involves supporting diagnostic calibration, validation, and fault management activities for engine and aftertreatment systems, enabling robust diagnostic performance and compliance across vehicle development programs
   

  

 At PACCAR, you’ll be part of a purpose\-driven organization known for engineering excellence, innovation, and a strong commitment to employee growth and well\-being. We foster a collaborative, inclusive environment where your ideas are valued, your contributions make a real difference, and your career can thrive as you help build world\-class products that power the future of transportation.
   

  

**Job Function / Responsibilities**
* Support fault management and diagnostic calibration activities for engine and aftertreatment systems.
* Perform diagnostic validation across HIL, engine, and vehicle test environments.
* Execute OBD calibration activities and validate electrical signals and diagnostic functionality.
* Create and maintain test cases to support diagnostic verification and validation activities.
* Perform fault simulation and diagnostic evaluations using approved technical documentation.
* Analyse diagnostic and field test data to identify issues and support corrective actions.
* Prepare calibration reports, validation summaries, and technical recommendations.
* Support troubleshooting activities during product development and validation phases.
* Perform IUMPR analysis to assess OBD monitor performance and compliance
* Participate in at least one scheduled weekend support activity per month to support project, testing, or release requirements.


**Qualification**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechatronics / Mechanical / Automobile / Electronics Engineering


**Required Skills**
**Technical / Professional Experience Requirements:** 
 3 to 6 Years
   

  

**Domain Knowledge:** 
 Automotive – Diagnostics and Calibration
   

  

**Primary Skills:** 
 Engine diagnostics, fault management, OBD systems, diagnostic calibration, diagnostic validation, electrical schematics, logic diagrams, fault simulation.
   

  

**Secondary Skills:** 
 Quality Center (ALM\-QC), MATLAB/Python Scripting
   

  

**Competencies And Behaviors**
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to interpret complex diagnostic data and test results.
* Structured approach to troubleshooting and issue investigation.
* Effective technical communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to collaborate with cross\-functional engineering teams.
* Attention to detail and commitment to engineering quality.

title: Senior Systems Engineer
description:
**Job Description – Linux L3 System Administrator** 




**Job Summary** 




 The Linux L3 System Administrator is responsible for advanced architecture, administration, troubleshooting, and optimization of large\-scale Linux environments. This role provides technical leadership, handles complex incidents and escalations, drives automation and standardization, and ensures platform stability, security, and performance across on‑premise and cloud infrastructures.
 



  
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Provide L3\-level support for Linux OS (RHEL, Oracle Linux, CentOS, Rocky Linux)
* Act as final technical escalation point for complex OS, performance, and availability issues
* Lead major incident troubleshooting, perform deep\-dive analysis, and deliver Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* Design, build, and maintain highly available and scalable Linux platforms
* Own OS builds, upgrades, kernel updates, and lifecycle management
* Architect and support LVM, multipathing (DM‑Multipath, PowerPath), and enterprise storage integrations
* Implement and maintain automation using Ansible, shell scripting, Python
* Provide advanced support for VMware and physical server infrastructures
* Drive security hardening, vulnerability remediation, and audit compliance
* Support cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) – OS provisioning, optimization, and troubleshooting
* Collaborate with application, database, network, and security teams on solution design
* Mentor L1/L2 engineers and review SOPs, standards, and best practices
* Participate in 24x7 on\-call rotations and planned maintenance activities



  
 



 Required Skills \& Experience
 


* 8–10\+ years of enterprise Linux system administration experience
* Deep expertise in RHEL/Oracle Linux
* Strong experience with:
+ LVM, multipathing, SAN/NAS storage
+ System performance tuning and analysis
+ Advanced troubleshooting in production

* Hands\-on experience with Ansible automation
* Strong shell scripting skills (Bash); Python desirable
* Experience with ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM tools
* Strong understanding of networking concepts (bonding, VLANs, routing basics)
* Experience supporting 24x7 mission‑critical environments



  
 



 Preferred Qualifications
 


* RHCE / RHCA or equivalent certifications
* Experience with container platforms (Docker/Kubernetes) – OS perspective
* Exposure to cloud\-native Linux deployments
* Experience in ITIL\-aligned operations



  
 



 Professional Attributes
 


* Strong ownership mindset and decision‑making capabilities
* Ability to handle high‑pressure, business‑critical incidents
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Passion for automation, standardization, and continuous improvement

Senior Rust Systems Engineer – Embedded Proxy & Appliance
description:
Senior Rust Systems Engineer – Embedded Proxy \& Appliance
 
 Remote, India \| Direct Hire \| 6\+ Years Total (3\+ Years Production Rust)
 



**About Securly** 




 Securly is a K\-12 EdTech company built around one mission: keeping students safe and well, both online and off. Our platform gives schools the infrastructure to filter and monitor web traffic, flag signs of self\-harm or bullying, and support student wellness — all while giving IT teams tools that hold up on real school networks, not just in a demo. That mission runs straight through this role: the edge proxy appliance is core infrastructure sitting inside thousands of school networks, and it has to work every single school day, at scale, without fail.
 



 We're a team of roughly 330 people across Pune, the US, and the UK, working across engineering, product, and customer\-facing teams to build and support that platform. Engineering in Pune plays a central role in building the systems that make Securly's safety mission possible — this isn't a satellite team, it's where core infrastructure like this gets built.
 



**The Role** 




 If you've spent your career close to the hardware — device drivers, kernel modules, cross\-compilation, bring\-up on constrained systems — and you're deep in production Rust, this is a chance to own the embedded proxy software running on a fleet of appliances deployed across thousands of school networks, from the OS layer up through the AWS control plane managing it all.
 



**Must\-Haves:** 



* Embedded Linux fundamentals — device drivers, kernel modules, cross\-compilation, or hardware bring\-up
* 3\+ years hands\-on production Rust in a systems or embedded context (not app/web Rust)
* 6\+ years total engineering experience
* Systems/network programming — TCP stream handling, socket programming, transparent proxying
* Docker/containerization for constrained/appliance deployment
* Performance testing and profiling — load testing, memory/CPU profiling, flame graph analysis
* Working knowledge of AWS and IaC concepts



**Strongly Preferred:** 
 Named fleet/IoT/embedded device product on your resume, C/C\+\+ or Go alongside Rust, eBPF/netfilter/HAProxy/Envoy exposure
 



**Nice to Have:** 
 RADIUS, observability (CloudWatch/Splunk/SLOs)
 



 Securly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristic.
